vBRIEFInfo.description: Scope: AI engine — three difficulty levels

narrative.Overview: Implement the AI opponent with three difficulty levels. Depends on Game Model Foundation.
narrative.Requirements: FR-7 (AI difficulty levels), NFR-3 (Hard AI must be provably optimal).
narrative.Tasks:
1. Easy: return a random valid cell from board.empty_cells().
2. Medium: scan for immediate winning move for AI; if none, scan for immediate winning move for opponent and block; otherwise random.
3. Hard: minimax with alpha-beta pruning on Board.copy() — never mutate the real board. Heuristic: +1 win, -1 loss, 0 draw, scored relative to AI player. Alpha-beta prunes at depth limit if needed (3×3×3 is tractable without depth limit).
4. Expose get_move(board, player, difficulty) -> int as the single AI entry point.
5. Write tests/test_ai.py: Hard AI never loses in 1000 randomized games; Medium always blocks a forced win on next move.
narrative.Acceptance: pytest tests/test_ai.py passes. Hard AI returns a move in under 2 seconds on an empty board.
